bosses.name: Beast Dog
bosses.strategy:
Be wary of its Breath of Fire attack; it'll hit the whole part for pretty
good damage. Have each person heal themselves after the hit to be safe.
Its physical attacks are bad enough, but it will increase its own
strength, making them that much worse, so keep an eye on your HP.
To start, have Margarete cast the Aqua Edge on Yuri, followed by using
her Grenade skill repeatedly. With a water-based attack, have Yuri fuse
into the Raging Tiger and start attacking normally, doing some major
damage. Have Alice keep everyone's HP up during the battle, having
Margarete help out when needed. As usual, make sure Alice's SP doesn't
drop to 0.

After a long series of events, you'll gain control inside the city of Fengtian.
Head over to the right side of the screen and talk to the Silent Peddler; he'll
give you the [_PEDOMETER_], which will count the steps you take when you have
it equipped. Later on, you'll be able to trade your 'steps' for prizes, so make
sure to ALWAYS have it equipped on an active party member; I put mine on Alice.

Go to the north side of the area behind the fountain until you see the '?'
icon. You'll find a [_TALISMANOFLUCK_] here. Next, head to the left side of the
fountain and talk to the man in green, the Building-Loving Man. Since you have
a Lottery Ticket from the Felinus battle, he'll offer to let you play the
Lottery! IGNORE him for now, as we'll be able to save here in a few moments so
that if we fail, we can reload and try again.

After talking to everyone, go back and talk to Alice to have her rejoin you.
Head west to the next area, then check the alley just to your upper-right to
find a chest containing a [_TENT_]. Approach the building to the left to have
the shopkeeper invite you in, then enter the shop for a scene.

Talk to the shopkeeper to learn about using your Guild Card that you acquired
earlier, which will allow you to get a 10% discount while shopping and a 5%
price rise when selling. As you can see, everything here is pretty expensive,
so you probably won't be able to buy much more than Yuri's and Alice's upgrades
for their weapons and armor. Make sure that you have some money left over to
have enough for a few Tents if needed, as well as necessary healing items.

  NOTE     I STRONGLY recommend saving before shopping. If you fail at the Ring
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   while trying to get discounts, you can always reload and try again.
           If you fail while not having enough money to purchase enough times,
           you can lose your card, so avoid it if at all possible.

Meiyuan is here as well, but I don't recommend using his acupuncture just yet;
it's too expensive for the bonus. When you're done shopping, attempt to leave;
Alice will ask if you're ready.

——————————————————————————
   [1] Just a bit more.
   [2] I'm ready.
——————————————————————————

Choose 2 to watch a series of events. Eventually, you'll regain control outside
in the alley. Check to your left to find another [_LOTTERY TICKET_], then go
back into the Item Shop and SAVE your game. The Building-loving Man is in here
now, and you'll be able to play the Lottery with him.

  NOTE     There are a very limited amount of Lottery Tickets in the game (30
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   to be exact), so (FOR NOW) I only recommend playing each person's
           lottery ONCE, and that is to get the item in RED. You MUST win a
           prize from each member's game once if you want to be able to
           participate in EVERY member's lottery, including the chairman's, so
           try not to miss any!

Make sure to win the Jade Lariat before continuing on; it widens your Hit Area
on your Ring, it's well worth it! If you don't win it, reload your last save
and try again.

Once you've done everything you want in Fengtian, go back out into the alley
and examine the ladder in the manhole to descend into the sewers.

  NOTE     At any point in the Sewers, if needed, you can return to the Item
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Shop to save and/or shop.


   Sewers
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Take a few steps to the right, then examine the stairs at the bottom of the
screen to find a [_GOLD HOURGLASS_]. Go back to the ladder and head north now,
taking the first left when you can. You'll eventually come to a chest, so open
it for a [_PURE SEED_], then go back to the last fork. Take the SECOND left
this time, and you'll come to a hole in the wall. After the scene, examine it
again to receive a [_LOTTERY TICKET_].

Head back to the fork once again to run into the Alluring Spy. This time,
she'll decide to join your party, and will introduce herself as Margarete.

  NOTE     Margarete comes equipped with a [_MINI-MAUSER_], and a
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   [_LEATHER SKIRT_] by default.

Make your way back to the ladder once more, then head east, north, and east to
an area with a Save Point. Use it if you like, then examine the ladder here for
an event. Afterward, continue west and you'll eventually come back to the chest
you passed earlier. Open it for a [_TYPE 94 PISTOL_] for Margarete; it
increases her P-Atk, but not her S-ATK, but I'd still equip it anyway.

Since you saw the event at the ladder, there's now one more item we need to
get. Make your way back to the first ladder you came down, then head all the
way north. The blast created some debris here, so cross it and examine the
glowing blue sphere in the wall to obtain the [_JEWEL_], which is the Sealing
Stone for the manhole cover. Once you have it, search just to the right of it
to find a [_ROSEWOOD BRACELET_].

Make your way back to the Save Point and save your game, then attempt to climb
the ladder; you'll be asked if you want to set the Sealing Stone.

—————————————————————————
   [1] Wait a moment.
   [2] Okay, it's set.
—————————————————————————

Make sure you're ready for battle, then choose 2 to face a sub-boss.

|  the Kappas first, since they have the ability to heal. Have Margarete use  |
|  her Grenade skill until she's out of MP, then have her attack normally.    |
|  Have Alice attack normally, unless she's needed for healing. If you want   |
|  to do some extra damage to the Water Tiger once the Kappas are gone, have  |

|  Water Tiger.                                                               |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'
    \   00400 EXP   / \   02500 Cash   /
     '—————————————'   '——————————————'

After that battle, use the Save Point, as well as a Tent, since we have a boss
battle next. When you're ready, check the ladder one more time. Move ahead?

——————————————————————————
   [1] Keep searching.
   [2] Go above ground.
——————————————————————————

Nothing left to do but go on ahead, so choose 2 to climb the ladder and watch
the events. You'll have to take on two groups of Elite Guards, which are pretty
simple. After that though, you'll have to take on a beastly demon.

Save your game, then choose to go to Dalian.
